status.noChanges: No active changes. Start one with /sdlc:intent (Claude Code), /sdlc-intent (OpenCode), or `sdlc new <name>`.
next.reviseArtifact: The {gate} gate was {reason}. Revise the {artifacts} artifact(s), then ask for approval again.
next.reapprove: The {gate} artifacts changed after approval; {who} must re-approve.
next.approve: {who} must review and approve the {gate} gate ({artifacts}).
next.implementNone: Implement the approved plan (no tasks tracked yet).
next.implementRemain: Implement the approved plan: {remaining} of {total} task(s) remain.
next.verifyFailed: Verification failed: fix the code (not the tests), then run `sdlc verify` again.
next.verifyStale: Code changed since the last passing verification: run `sdlc verify` again.
next.verifyRun: Run the verification loop and record the evidence with `sdlc verify`.
next.reviewRun: Run the multi-pass review (bugs, security, compliance with spec and plan) and record findings in review.md.
next.fixFindings: Address {count} open blocking finding(s) in review.md, re-verify, and update their status.
next.reviewReapprove: Code or review.md changed after review approval. A code owner must re-approve.
next.reviewApprove: A code owner must read review.md and the diff, then approve the review gate.
next.releasePrepare: Prepare release.md (rollout, rollback, monitoring) for release authorization.
next.releaseApprove: A release manager must authorize the release.
next.archive: All gates are satisfied: archive the change to merge its delta specs into openspec/specs/.

init.welcome:
sdlc — Software Development Lifecycle harness

This wizard sets up OpenSpec and the SDLC harness for the coding tools you choose.
Nothing is written until you confirm the summary at the end.
init.mode.block: block — hooks deny actions that skip a gate
init.statusline: Install the Claude Code status line?
init.indexCodegraph: Index this project with codegraph (codegraph init)?
cmd.program: AI-native SDLC harness (Anthropic playbook) for Claude Code and OpenCode, built on OpenSpec.
cmd.roles.check: Check who can approve each gate
cmd.roles.who: Show eligible people for a gate
cmd.roles.migrate: Move configured roles into roles.yaml (human only)
cmd.backlog: Manage planned changes in priority order
cmd.backlog.next: Show the next ready backlog item
cmd.backlog.start: Start a backlog item as a change
cmd.layout: Check or create the AI-ready project layout
cmd.init: Set up the harness: OpenSpec root, sdlc schema, openspec/sdlc.yaml, agent integrations
cmd.update: Regenerate schema, skills, commands, agents, hooks and plugin after upgrading
cmd.uninstall: Remove generated agent files and hooks (keeps openspec/ and all planning data)
cmd.new: Start a change (an OpenSpec change folder plus its SDLC record)
cmd.explore: Create or list optional exploration notes before intent
cmd.status: Lifecycle dashboard: stage, gates, approvals, evidence, and who must act next
cmd.statusline: Print the Claude Code status line
cmd.track.set: Set full or lite track (human only)
cmd.next: The next action for a change and who performs it
cmd.instructions: Instructions for an artifact: intent|proposal|specs|design|plan|tasks|apply (OpenSpec) or verification|review|release
cmd.approve: Approve a gate (intent|spec|plan|review|release) - human only, bound to the current content
cmd.reject: Reject a gate with a note - human only
cmd.waive: Waive a gate with a recorded reason - human only
cmd.approvals.verify: Verify approval and roles commit signatures
cmd.tests: lock | unlock test files for a bug-fix change (unlock is human only)
cmd.tests.unlock: lock | unlock test files for a bug-fix change (unlock is human only)
cmd.verify: Run the configured checks and record literal evidence (the verify gate)
cmd.review: context (diff, policy, plan drift) | check (open blocking findings in review.md)
cmd.validate: openspec validate --strict plus harness delta checks and cross-change overlaps
cmd.archive: Check every required gate, then merge delta specs via openspec archive
cmd.audit: Audit trail and SDLC metrics (lead times, first-pass verification, rejections)
cmd.log: Project log (openspec/.sdlc/log.jsonl): harness events with the sdlc version and license of each
cmd.license: Show the sdlc version and the license this project uses sdlc under; `set community|commercial` records a change (human only)
cmd.license.set: Show the sdlc version and the license this project uses sdlc under; `set community|commercial` records a change (human only)
cmd.doctor: Check the installation: OpenSpec, schema, generated files, hooks, CLI on PATH, verify commands, license
cmd.plugin.build: Render the workflows, subagents and hooks as a Claude Code plugin (default dir: ./plugin)
cmd.hook: Policy dispatcher for agent hooks: pre-tool | session-start | stop (reads JSON on stdin)
cmd.openspec: Run the bundled OpenSpec CLI (e.g. `sdlc openspec list --specs`)
workflow.help.title: SDLC: Help
workflow.help.description: Show available SDLC workflows and the current project state.
workflow.next.title: SDLC: Next
workflow.next.description: Advance an SDLC change to its next step in the AI-native lifecycle (intent, spec, plan, build, verify, review, release, archive). Use when the user says "continue", "next step", "what's next", or wants to move a change forward without naming the stage.
workflow.status.title: SDLC: Status
workflow.status.description: Show the SDLC dashboard - every active change with its stage (plan, design, build, test, deploy), gate states, approvals, verification and review status, and who must act next. Use when the user asks for status, progress, what is blocked, or what needs approval.
workflow.explore.title: SDLC: Explore
workflow.explore.description: Research and pressure-test an idea before deciding whether to write intent.
workflow.intent.title: SDLC: Intent
workflow.intent.description: Capture an idea, request, ticket or problem as intent.md, the Stage 1 (Plan) artifact of the AI-native SDLC, for product-owner approval. Use when the user describes something they want built or fixed, or says "new idea", "capture intent", "start a change".
workflow.spec.title: SDLC: Spec
workflow.spec.description: Turn an accepted intent into the requirements and design spec (Stage 2, Design) - OpenSpec proposal.md, delta specs and design.md with policies applied and areas of concern flagged. Use after the intent gate is approved, or when the user asks to write or refine requirements or the design.
workflow.plan.title: SDLC: Plan
workflow.plan.description: Produce the implementation plan (Stage 3, Build) from an approved spec - plan.md (files that change, order of work, risks, proof, rollback) and tasks.md - for engineer approval before any code is written. Use after the spec gate is approved or when the user asks for an implementation plan.
workflow.build.title: SDLC: Build
workflow.build.description: Implement an SDLC change from its approved plan (Stage 3, Build) with a continuous feedback loop - work through tasks.md, run the project's checks after each step, keep plan.md in sync. Use when the plan gate is approved and the user asks to implement, build, or apply the change.
workflow.verify.title: SDLC: Verify
workflow.verify.description: Verify an implemented SDLC change (Stage 4, Test) - run the project's checks with `sdlc verify` to record literal evidence, then get an independent behavioral verification against the spec scenarios in a fresh context. Use after implementation, or when the user asks to test, verify, or check that a change works.
workflow.review.title: SDLC: Review
workflow.review.description: Review a verified SDLC change (Stage 5, Deploy) in independent passes - bugs, security, compliance with the spec, plan and design principles in REVIEW.md - record severity-ranked findings in review.md, fix the important ones, and hand off to a human code owner. Use when the user asks for a review, a PR review, or to address review findings.
workflow.release.title: SDLC: Release
workflow.release.description: Prepare an approved SDLC change for release (Stage 5, Deploy) - release.md with changelog, per-environment rollout, monitoring signals and a rehearsed rollback - up to the production gate, which a release manager authorizes. Use when the user asks to release, ship, or deploy a change.
workflow.archive.title: SDLC: Archive
workflow.archive.description: Close a completed SDLC change - confirm every required gate is satisfied, merge its delta specs into the living specs via OpenSpec archive, and capture learnings (evals, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md rules, follow-up intents). Use when the user asks to archive, finish, or close a change.
workflow.triage.title: SDLC: Triage
workflow.triage.description: Close the loop (Stage 6, Maintain) - turn an alert, incident, failing build, security finding or ticket into a diagnosed, evidence-backed intent.md that re-enters the lifecycle. Use when the user pastes an alert, incident, error report or scan finding, or asks to investigate a production problem.
hook.separationOfDuties: Gate approvals, rejections, waivers, test unlocks, track selection and backlog priority are human decisions. Ask the responsible person to run the command in their own terminal.
hook.stateIntegrityBash: .sdlc.yaml and openspec/.sdlc/log.jsonl hold gate approvals, evidence and the audit log; only the sdlc CLI may change them. Use `sdlc` commands instead of editing them.
hook.stateIntegrityEdit: .sdlc.yaml and openspec/.sdlc/log.jsonl hold gate approvals, evidence and the audit log; only the sdlc CLI may change them.
hook.releaseGate: This looks like a production release (matched /{pattern}/). Production releases need a named release authorization: a release manager runs `sdlc approve release --change <id>` after reviewing release.md (or sets SDLC_RELEASE_APPROVAL for this session). The agent prepares the release; it does not authorize it.
hook.protectedPath: {path} is a protected path (enforcement.protected_paths in openspec/sdlc.yaml). Change it through its owning process, not in an agent session.
hook.testsLocked: Tests are locked for change '{change}' (fix-first protocol): the failing test is the proof, so fix the code, not {path}. A person can unlock with `sdlc tests unlock --change {change}`.
hook.planGateNone: No SDLC change covers this edit ({path}). Nothing is implemented without an accepted plan: start with /sdlc:intent (or `sdlc new <name>`), or keep the edit out of scope.
hook.planGatePending: No active change has an approved plan yet ({changes}). Finish the plan and have an engineer run `sdlc approve plan --change <id>` before editing {path}.
hook.verifyBeforeStop: Change '{change}' has all tasks checked but no passing verification for the current code ({detail}). Run `sdlc verify --change {change}` and paste the evidence before finishing.
session.header: SDLC harness ({stamp}): active changes in openspec/changes (run `sdlc status` for details).
session.enforcement: Enforcement mode is {mode}. Gate approvals are made by people with `sdlc approve`, never by the agent.
gate.stale: content changed after approval; re-approval needed
gate.noArtifacts: schema '{schema}' has no artifacts for this gate
gate.verifyStale: code changed since the last passing `sdlc verify`
gate.verifyNoCommands: no verification commands configured (verify.commands in openspec/sdlc.yaml)
gate.noReview: no review.md yet (run the review workflow)
report.title: {name} SDLC progress ({since} to {until})
report.summaryLine: {active} active · {archived} archived · {blocked} blocked · {awaiting} awaiting a person
report.leadLine: Intent to spec: {a} · Spec to plan: {b} · Plan to verified: {c} · Verified to review: {d} · Created to archived: {e}
report.html.title: {name} · SDLC progress
